title: 78 #### 5.6 Juveniles arrested classified according to Age: The statistics of juveniles and youthful offenders apprehended over the past eight years revealed that more than 60-0 per cent of the juveniles apprehended belonged to 16 to 21 age group. The arrests of juvenile offenders under this age group recorded increase till the year 1971 when the percentage of arrests under this age group was 82-4 per cent the maximum recorded so far. In 1972, the percentage of juvenile apprehended under this age group decreased and was 78-5 per cent. For 1973 and 1974 a steady increase, in arrest of juveniles belonging to 16 to 21 age group was recorded. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 37.
